name: pond-tracker
description: Phone-first catch log for pond management: relative weight, PSD and cull guidance for bass and bluegill.

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w app && npm run build -w api
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w app --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w app && npm run typecheck -w api
